channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US H-1B visa rules may tighten: Trump administration clears review of proposal to end 60-day grace period after layoffs
item.description: Details of the proposed regulation are not yet public. If the proposal moves forward, it will be published in the Federal Register, followed by a public comment period, typically lasting 30 to 60 days.

item.title: Lionel Richie hospitalised in ICU after St Louis concert
item.description: Lionel Richie has been hospitalised in St Louis after his weekend concert, with sources saying doctors are evaluating him for possible slight dehydration.

item.title: Grand Canyon Under Storm Threat After Deadly Weekend Floods
item.description: Another round of heavy rain is threatening to complicate search-and-rescue efforts in the Grand Canyon, where two people died and more than a dozen are still missing after catastrophic floods swept through popular hiking areas Saturday.

item.title: Trump calls Iran a ‘failed nation’, says ‘IT IS DEAD’ in scathing attack
item.description: Trump also claimed that Iran has lost key military and economic capabilities, alleging that the country has “no Navy” and “no Air Force” and that its currency has collapsed.

item.title: ‘Drunk’ pilot steals plane, flies into no-fly zone before crash-landing in sunflower field
item.description: The aircraft made an emergency landing in a sunflower field around four miles from the nuclear facility. The plane suffered extensive damage, but the pilot was able to escape without sustaining injuries.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Optimus Prime: 'There's a thin line between being a hero, and being a memory'
item.description: Optimus Prime’s words in Transformers capture the fleeting nature of heroism, taking on added poignancy through Peter Cullen’s legacy as the voice behind the iconic Autobot leader and Eeyore.

item.title: Lionel Messi Net Worth 2026: Salary, endorsements, cars, properties and luxury assets
item.description: Lionel Messi retired from international football in August 2026 after a remarkable career with Argentina, continuing at Inter Miami.&nbsp;

item.title: John Galliano withdraws from Met Gala 2027 after backlash over past racist, antisemitic remarks: ‘I’m deeply sorry'
item.description: John Galliano has withdrawn from the Met’s planned exhibition celebrating his career after criticism over his past racist and anti semitic remarks, saying he did not want the controversy to overshadow the museum’s work.

item.title: Lionel Messi announces retirement; fans struggle to accept: ‘Poetic ending to his GOAT career’
item.description: The football star, who is adored by millions of supporters worldwide, left fans devastated and in disbelief.

item.title: Tribunal twist: NCLT to hear Chandra plan again, this time with a bigger bench
item.description: The NCLT said there was no majority view on Chandra’s repayment plan. One member had favoured applying the repayment plan only to creditors who supported it, while another member held that the plan should apply to all creditors, including those who opposed it

item.title: J&K FDA prohibits sale, storage and distribution of 10 ghee batches: Why were they banned and what it means
item.description: An order issues by the Jammu and Kashmir FDA prohibited the sale, storage, distribution and display of 10 identified brands/batches of ghee across the Union Territory after laboratory analysis found the products to be sub-standard, unsafe and misbranded, the reports said.

item.title: After Tata, India eyes second chip fab by 2031 with at least $2bn investment
item.description: India has launched Semicon 2.0 with a ₹1.28 trillion budget to fund a second commercial silicon fabrication plant by 2031 alongside its first display fab.&nbsp;

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe in action again | FDA busts expiry date racket, seizes Maggi, Lay’s, Kurkure in Navi Mumbai
item.description: The seized stock included potato chips and snacks such as Lay’s, Kurkure variants and Fun Flips, along with Maggi Masala and Atta Noodles.

item.title: Iran economic crisis deepens: Food prices soar, Rial at record low as US launches new sanctions
item.description: With inflation surging, the rial weakening and sanctions adding further pressure, Iran’s leadership faces a difficult choice between continuing confrontation and pursuing diplomacy to ease economic pressure.

item.title: ₹1.33 crore interest with full refund: Dubai buyer wins property dispute with Mumbai builder
item.description: MahaRERA's ruling protects buyers by limiting builders' deductions upon cancellation and mandating refunds within 45 days. MahaREAT ordered a builder to refund a Dubai-based buyer for two cancelled flats.

item.title: Trump wants Apple to follow Google Maps and rename Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’
item.description: Donald Trump has reportedly asked Apple to rename Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ on its maps, while Google Maps has already adopted the name for users in the US.

item.title: UAE scam alert: Dubai consulate warns Indians against fake agents promising visas, jobs and Emirates IDs
item.description: The advisory comes amid concerns over identity and financial fraud, with the mission stressing that biometric information such as fingerprints and facial scans can be particularly sensitive and should only be submitted through authorised government channels.

item.title: PM Modi tells Putin: ‘Every day of war sets humanity back’, calls for end to Ukraine hostilities
item.description: The two leaders held talks on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, as India continues to balance its close strategic partnership with Russia with its longstanding call for dialogue and diplomacy to end the Ukraine war.

item.title: Air India Dammam-Delhi flight makes emergency landing after ‘bomb’ written on tissue
item.description: An Air India flight from Dammam in Saudi Arabia to New Delhi with 32 passengers made an emergency landing at the Ahmedabad airport on Monday after a crew member found a tissue paper bearing a message that there was a ‘bomb’ on board the aircraft, police said.

item.title: Below-normal September rains raise crop, inflation risks
item.description: Another spell of weak rainfall could hit kharif crops and vegetables, hurting farm incomes, rural demand and food prices, experts said

item.title: Queen Camilla puts differences with Prince Harry aside as King Charles seeks closer family ties: Royal experts
item.description: Queen Camilla is expected to support King Charles as Prince Harry seeks to rebuild ties with the royal family following years of estrangement and public criticism.&nbsp;

item.title: Labor Day 2026: Date, history, origins, significance. Is it a federal holiday? Are schools closed?
item.description: Labor Day is an annual US holiday celebrating the social and economic achievements of American workers. It emerged from the labour movement of the late 19th century, when workers and labour activists pushed for better working conditions and greater recognition of the contribution of working people.

item.title: Bengaluru to ban two-wheelers, autos on 5 flyovers: Check date, timings and other details
item.description: The restrictions, announced on Sunday, will apply to five flyovers and elevated corridors, with separate rules for goods vehicles, autorickshaws and two-wheelers.

item.title: ‘Stop ChatGPT’: 14-year-old Twitter post goes viral, sparks memes and conspiracy theories about time travel
item.description: An old Twitter post from 2012 warns against ChatGPT, despite the AI's 2022 launch. It has gone viral, sparking theories of time travel.&nbsp;

item.title: Planning to move to US? Indian man has a blunt message: ‘America mat aao’
item.description: Anushk Sharma, who said he has personally assisted students planning to study in the US, said he was no longer comfortable recommending the country amid the current uncertainty.

item.title: 'Never recognised existence of...': India rejects Hague arbitration court ruling on Indus Waters Treaty
item.description: The foreign ministry said India has never recognised the existence of the Court of Arbitration on the IWT.

item.title: Delhi High Court rejects German firm's plea against C-DOT's emergency-alert deal
item.description: Utimaco Technologies challenged the no-tender appointment of C-DOT on procurement grounds, but the government defended the project as a strategic national asset vital to security.

item.title: SCO Summit: PM Modi meets Iran President Pezeshkian for first time since Gulf war — What was discussed
item.description: In a post on X, Modi shared pictures from the meeting and said the two leaders discussed the prevailing situation in the region. He added that India would continue to support all efforts aimed at ensuring lasting peace in the region.

item.title: 2 flats, ₹39,000 rent, ₹85 lakh savings: Can this Delhi couple retire early? X user asks
item.description: Amit Arora revealed that the husband earns around ₹1.5 lakh per month, while his wife earns ₹22,000 from tuitions, taking their total monthly income to about ₹1.72 lakh.

item.title: US-Iran war: Why Larak island, Jordan and Egypt's Banque Misr are targets in latest flare-up
item.description: In the first known flare-up in violence between Iran and the US since late July, Washington struck Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, followed by Iran's retaliatory strikes on US bases in Jordan. Earlier, the US moved to cut off the UAE's branches of Banque Misr from the US financial system.

item.title: What is analogue dairy? Zomato bans such dishes to ‘safeguard customer health’ and ‘uphold clear standards’
item.description: Zomato enforces a ‘zero tolerance’ policy for analogue dairy dishes in India, effective 31 August 2026. Non-compliant restaurants may be removed from the platform.&nbsp;

item.title: Delhi HC appoints forensic auditor to examine Fortis-linked transactions in Daiichi case
item.description: The Delhi High Court ordered a forensic audit into complex asset transfers involving Fortis Healthcare, RHT Health Trust, and IHH Healthcare. This moves Daiichi Sankyo closer to tracing diverted funds to enforce its long-standing ₹3,500-crore arbitration award against the Singh brothers.

item.title: US to end work permit for spouses of H-1B visa holders? No need to panic yet — All about the buzz over H-4 EAD program
item.description: The Trump administration is considering ending employment authorisation for some spouses of H-1B visa holders. But there's no need to panic yet. Here's all you need to know about the buzz.

item.title: Quote of the Day: 'You will never find time for anything…' — a lesson from Charles Buxton
item.description: Charles Buxton's timeless observation offers a simple lesson about productivity: meaningful goals rarely get accomplished by waiting for free time. They require deliberate choices and space in our schedules.

item.title: NIIF raises $2 billion towards Infra Fund 2's first close, largest till date
item.description: NIIF has raised ₹19,000 crore for the first close of Fund II and is targeting $3.2 billion. The fund will expand beyond core infra into EVs and urban infrastructure, with $950 million for co-investments.
